description: Citation ledger: real evidence backing every token/section/template decision in this design-repo. Degrades gracefully (a warning, not a failure) when the sibling source project is not present, per BUILD-GUIDE 2.7's self-containment rule — this design-repo does NOT depend on these external paths existing for its own schema/adversarial validation to run.
siblingSourceNote: This file cites files OUTSIDE design-repo/ (the sibling project the design-repo was extracted from) purely as a build-time evidence trail. registry.manifest.json's entryPoints deliberately does NOT reference any of these — see MASTER-GUIDE 3.9.

frameworkCorrection.claim: sourceProject.framework is React 19 (react ^19.2.8, react-dom ^19.2.8), NOT React 18 as README.md's opening line states.
frameworkCorrection.readmeDiscrepancy: README.md:3 says 'A React 18 + Vite + Tailwind v3 rebuild' — stale/incorrect against the real package.json. This design-repo cites package.json, not the README's opening line, for the framework field.

sharedChromeFinding.claim: Banner/Navbar/Footer render identically on ALL 8 real routes + the wildcard 404, not just the 4 named in App.jsx's own comment.
sharedChromeFinding.measuredFrom: ../src/App.jsx:16-18 (comment), ../src/App.jsx:36-63 (Shell wraps all Routes identically), ../src/components/Banner.jsx, ../src/components/Navbar.jsx, ../src/components/Footer.jsx (none of the three import useLocation or take route-dependent props)
sharedChromeFinding.verification: grep -n 'useLocation|pathname|props' on Navbar.jsx/Footer.jsx/Banner.jsx returned 0 matches — confirms zero per-route conditional logic in any of the three components.

invented_logos.claim: 9 real third-party customer logos are not reproduced; 9 original invented wordmarks ship instead at the same 5:1 aspect ratio.
invented_logos.measuredFrom: ../README.md:74-80; ../public/assets/logos/*.svg (9 files confirmed: cascadia, halcyon, lumenline, meridian, northwind, orbital, quanta, stratafold, verdant)

placeholder_legal.claim: /privacy-policy and /terms use representative placeholder prose with a REQUIRED, visibly-rendered in-page notice.
placeholder_legal.measuredFrom: ../src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.jsx:161-173; ../src/pages/Terms.jsx:132-141 — both confirmed to render a role="note" warning-colored banner directly above the body prose, not merely claimed in a comment.

no_outbound_links.claim: All links to the real reference site resolve to '#'; the demo form is local state only and performs zero network requests.
no_outbound_links.independentVerification: grep -rniE 'https?://|fetch\(|XMLHttpRequest|axios' src/ during this build found zero real external-request call sites — only XML namespace URIs (xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg") in inline SVG markup, which are not network requests.

self_hosted_fonts.claim: Archivo (SIL OFL, substitute) and IBM Plex Mono (SIL OFL, exact match) are both self-hosted; zero external font requests.

notFoundLocation.claim: NotFound is defined inline in src/App.jsx (~line 21), NOT a separate src/pages/NotFound.jsx file.
notFoundLocation.verification: find src/pages -iname '*notfound*' -> 0 results, confirming no such file exists.
